# Lion-tailed monkey rope companion

Generated with the built-in image-generation tool using the supplied monkey photograph as a species reference. Transparent PNG; original alpha preserved. Tooltip wording supplied by the user.

Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: small transparent wildlife cutout for a portfolio website's hanging rope.
Input image: reference for species anatomy, silver mane, black fur, dark face and amber eyes only, not a background to reuse.
Primary request: Create one anatomically convincing lion-tailed macaque clinging calmly to an invisible thin vertical rope, in a relaxed naturally suspended pose. Style: detailed natural wildlife cutout, fine fur edges, softly lit, legible silhouette at small size, realistic rather than cartoon.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no backdrop or checkerboard baked in, no cast shadow rectangle.
Constraints: only one macaque; no text, logo, border, watermark or additional objects. All limbs and tail inside frame.
